fact: The locked Winter Walk Master Blueprint Executive Summary (Section 1 — "What value it creates") states that the OP Recommendation Adoption & Support System replaces manual OP adoption/support tracking across scattered emails, spreadsheets, and staff memory with a structured internal operating workflow for evidence tracking, reviewable follow-up, and human approval before consequential actions.
source_location: Section 1 Executive Summary — "What value it creates" (manual prior-state OP adoption/support tracking across emails, spreadsheets, staff memory; structured replacement workflow with evidence tracking, reviewable follow-up, human approval)
